rules.statement: The sale of sweep tickets is the sale of a chose in action, and Section 10 of the Prescription Ordinance applies with a three-year prescription period.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my view, therefore, section 8 of the Prescription Ordinance only applies to 'goods which are capable of being physically delivered' and not to the sale of incorporeal things such as a chose in action. In the latter case, Section 10 applies and the period of prescription would be three years."
